newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia July yr-on-yr industrial index up 12.5pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia July yr-on-yr industrial index up 12.5pct.

text.p: Malaysia's industrial production index rose 12.5 percent in July 1996 compared with July 1995, the national Bernama news agency reported on Saturday.
On a month-on-month comparison, the index was 5.2 percent higher than June 1996, the agency quoted the Statistics Department as saying.
The statistic department said all three divisions under the industrial sector -- mining, manufacturing and electricity -- contributed to the 241.8 points recorded by the index in July this year.
The growth of the mining sector was due to higher output of crude oil and natural gas.
The electricity sector grew with a 12.1 percent increase in power generation of electricity to 3,026 million kilowatt-hours.
